questions.question: What is the ISU Game Hub?
questions.answer: It is a hub of Iowa State themed games that our team built for COM S 3190: Jeopardy, Quiz Blitz, Family Feud, Maze and Memory Match. Pick a game, pick a mode, and play.

questions.question: Which games can I play right now?
questions.answer: All five. Jeopardy has a host mode and a multiple-choice team mode, Quiz Blitz has a 60-second mode and Sudden Death, Family Feud has a 3-round and a 6-round match, Maze lets you play or watch a solver, and Memory Match has an easy and a hard board.

questions.question: Why did we choose to create the ISU board?
questions.answer: We thought that with this project we would create a fun outcome, and an Iowa State themed game is something people on campus can enjoy.

questions.question: How do XP and levels work?
questions.answer: Every finished game earns XP, and each level needs a little more XP than the last. One game each day is the featured game and pays double XP. Your level shows in the top bar.

questions.question: How many teams can play?
questions.answer: Jeopardy and Family Feud are for two teams, Team A and Team B, taking turns on one screen. Quiz Blitz, Maze and Memory Match are single player.

questions.question: How does Jeopardy multiple choice mode work?
questions.answer: Teams take turns picking a tile and answering from four choices. A right answer wins the tile's value and keeps control of the board. A wrong answer loses the value and passes control. One tile is a Daily Double where the team picks its own wager.

questions.question: Are the Family Feud survey answers real?
questions.answer: No. The survey answers and their point values were made up for fun. They are not the result of a real survey.

questions.question: Are scores saved after I leave the game?
questions.answer: Yes. Scores, your level and your personal bests are saved in this browser on this device. They are not sent anywhere, and clearing your browser's site data resets them.

questions.question: Can I turn off the sound or the animations?
questions.answer: Use the speaker button in the top bar to mute sound. If your device is set to reduce motion, the hub turns off the heavy animations on its own.

questions.question: How do I add my own questions?
questions.answer: Jeopardy questions live in data/questions.json and the Quiz Blitz extras live in data/quiz.json. Add an entry with a correct answer and three wrong ones, and it shows up in the game.
